content.short: Cardano Native Token is a community-led Cardano project focused on treasury funding, collaboration, and support for ecosystem initiatives.
content.description: Cardano Native Token (CNT) is a community-led Cardano project built around shared treasury participation and ecosystem support. The project presents itself as a club-style community that pools resources to help fund, back, and expand Cardano-related initiatives while encouraging collaboration among holders and contributors. Its positioning is centered on grassroots participation, community treasury management, and long-term support for native-token projects across the ecosystem.
content.meta: Cardano Native Token is a community treasury project supporting Cardano-native initiatives and grassroots collaboration. Explore CNT on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
